inspection_history: The entire pre-holdout range has previously been inspected. Nested temporal scores are development evidence, not untouched confirmation.
sampling: Every twelfth canonical label-id-ordered row, selected before labels are read; time/label-id sorted afterwards. No family excluded.
outer_folds: Six equal chronological pre-holdout windows: seed window 0, evaluation windows 1 through 5. Only labels fully matured before each window start train the estimator.
inner_folds: For each outer training prefix, three equal chronological windows: seed 0, validation 1 and 2, with strict horizon maturity. Choose lowest pooled inner Brier; ties choose smaller C.
consistency_requirement: Every outer fold has positive causal Brier skill and pooled evidence passes all frozen calibration gates.
